title: Analyzing electrofishing CPUE with electrocpue
text: electrocpue turns raw multi-pass electrofishing records abundance, density, catch-per-unit-effort (CPUE) estimates. workflow four steps: Validate catch reach-metadata tables. Estimate removal-depletion abundance removal series. Analyze — wire validation, estimation, effort standardization, density together one call. Summarize repeat surveys reach level confidence intervals.

title: Analyzing electrofishing CPUE with electrocpue

text: analyze_cpue() everything returns one tidy row per reach × date × species. standardize effort amp-seconds, requires amperage column present example_catch. length-based (density_per_m) areal (density_per_m2) density returned; areal density NA reach area unavailable.

title: Analyzing electrofishing CPUE with electrocpue
text: summarize_cpue() collapses repeat visits per reach single reach × species summary confidence interval density. reported density random-effects pooled geometric mean, interval combines survey’s method-aligned likelihood uncertainty -survey variation log scale. reach flagged weak (n_identified records many surveys backed interval) surveys well enough identified support — low capture probability removal estimate biased, interval withheld rather shown confident bar.
code: smry <- summarize_cpue(res, level = 0.95) smry[, c("reach_id", "species", "n_surveys", "n_identified", "weak",          "N_mean", "density_per_m_mean",          "density_per_m_lwr", "density_per_m_upr")] #> # A tibble: 8 × 9 #>   reach_id species n_surveys n_identified weak  N_mean density_per_m_mean #>   <chr>    <chr>       <int>        <int> <lgl>  <dbl>              <dbl> #> 1 R01      BNT             2            2 FALSE  150                1.23  #> 2 R01      RBT             2            2 FALSE   64.5              0.533 #> 3 R02      BNT             2            2 FALSE   88                0.919 #> 4 R02      RBT             2            2 FALSE  126.               1.31  #> 5 R03      BNT             2            2 FALSE  200                1.36  #> 6 R03      RBT             2            2 FALSE   48.5              0.320 #> 7 R04      BNT             2            2 FALSE   60                0.748 #> 8 R04      RBT             2            2 FALSE   97                1.16  #> # ℹ 2 more variables: density_per_m_lwr <dbl>, density_per_m_upr <dbl>

title: Analyzing electrofishing CPUE with electrocpue
text: Identified reaches carry 95% interval; weak reach drawn hollow point bar (interval trustworthy).
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(smry, aes(x = reach_id, y = density_per_m_mean, colour = species)) +   geom_errorbar(     aes(ymin = density_per_m_lwr, ymax = density_per_m_upr),     width = 0.2,     position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)   ) +   geom_point(aes(shape = weak),              position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 2.5) +   scale_shape_manual(     values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 1),     labels = c(`FALSE` = "identified", `TRUE` = "weak"),     name   = "interval"   ) +   labs(     x = "Reach", y = "Density (fish / m)", colour = "Species",     title = "Estimated linear density by reach",     subtitle = "Pooled geometric mean; 95% random-effects intervals"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

title: Analyzing electrofishing CPUE with electrocpue
text: "zippin" — classic maximum-likelihood depletion estimator; reports NA catch series shows insufficient depletion. "carle_strub" — weighted-likelihood (Bayesian) estimator; robust depletion weak, recommended default routine use. "auto" — Zippin first, Carle & Strub fallback. Point estimates standard errors match FSA::removal(), results directly comparable reference implementation.

title: Analyze electrofishing CPUE end to end — analyze_cpue
text: catch_data long-format catch data frame (see validate_cpue_input()). reach_metadata reach metadata data frame least reach_id length_m; area_m2 used areal density present. method Removal estimator passed estimate_population(): "auto" (default), "zippin", "carle_strub". effort_basis Denominator effort-standardized catch rate: "seconds" (default) "amp_seconds". latter requires amperage column catch_data whose values present (non-NA), finite, positive. alpha, beta Carle & Strub prior parameters (see estimate_population()). validate Logical. TRUE (default), run validate_cpue_input() first. Set FALSE inputs already known valid: validation also guards structural assumptions pipeline relies – notably pass numbers contiguous 1 – skipping , say, non-contiguous passes (1, 2, 4) lets collapse silently wrong depletion series.

title: Analyze electrofishing CPUE end to end — analyze_cpue
text: data frame one row per reach_id x date x species columns: keys (reach_id, date, species); estimation (method, n_passes, catch_total, N, N_se, N_lwr, N_upr, p, p_se, converged, identifiable, note); reach extent (length_m, area_m2); effort (effort_seconds, effort_amp_seconds, effort_basis, cpue); density (density_per_m, density_per_m2). area_m2-dependent columns NA areal metadata absent.

title: electrocpue 0.3.0
text: -zero removal series longer assert N = 0. Use catch_total cpue observed zero, require converged consuming N. unbounded abundance interval now N_upr = Inf, rather exposing finite internal search cap. Check identifiable (.finite(N_upr)) treating upper limit bounded.

title: electrocpue 0.3.0
text: -zero removal series now reported unidentifiable (N, p, abundance limits NA; converged identifiable FALSE). observed catch CPUE remain zero, without treating detections proof zero population. Carle-Strub abundance limits now invert beta-weighted likelihood point estimate. Custom alpha beta values therefore affect , every converged point estimate contained reported limits. identifiable flag remains data-based rather promoted prior. Profile-likelihood abundance intervals now evaluate legitimate p = 1 boundary correctly, high-capture estimate N = catch contained interval. Reach density pooling now uses modified Knapp-Hartung inference, including conservative q >= 1 safeguard half-fish continuity width discrete singleton profile interval. prevents identical surveys erasing measurement uncertainty prevents zero-width inputs producing NaN limits. former factor-20 interval-width cap removed. density_per_m_mean density_per_m2_mean now report back-transformed random-effects geometric mean targeted log-scale intervals. N_mean remains descriptive arithmetic abundance mean. Profile-likelihood abundance intervals now use constant-memory integer binary searches. Results match former exhaustive candidate grid, large valid catches longer allocate vectors matrices proportional 50 * catch_total. profile weighted-likelihood interval remains admissible internal search cap, public upper limit now Inf identifiable = FALSE; implementation cap longer presented statistical bound.

title: electrocpue 0.3.0
text: Validation now rejects empty input tables, duplicate reach_metadata$reach_id keys, non-finite effort sampled reach extents. analysis join also guards metadata uniqueness callers explicitly skip validation, preventing duplicated reach rows silently reweighting summaries. Blank whitespace-species values now rejected every catch row, even another row survey valid species identifier. Removal counts, Carle-Strub priors, summary confidence levels, capture thresholds, analysis validation flag now reject malformed non-finite values package-classed errors. Shiny app’s CPUE plot now labels amp-second analyses correctly. Uploaded CSV/TSV parsing, helper plots, complete example-data server reactive path covered tests. htmltools tibble, Shiny app calls directly, now declared checked app dependencies. minimum R version now 4.2 locked tritonIngest dependency requires .

title: electrocpue 0.2.0
text: depletion-summary confidence intervals rebuilt review found previous method produced impossible unstable bounds. new method verified Monte-Carlo simulation. Per-survey profile-likelihood intervals. estimate_population() (zippin_estimate() / carle_strub_estimate()) now return N_lwr/N_upr – profile-likelihood limits respect N >= catch right-skew estimate – plus identifiable flag FALSE data bound abundance (low capture probability). replace reliance symmetric large-sample N_se, whose Wald interval fall catch. Reach intervals random-effects pooling. summarize_cpue() pools well-identified surveys’ profile uncertainty -survey variation log scale (DerSimonian-Laird Knapp-Hartung-Sidik-Jonkman variance), interval stays positive, carries survey’s depletion uncertainty, explode two visits. Verified reach-mean coverage 0.92-0.96 capture probability >= 0.45; ad-hoc truncation zero gone. Weak reaches flagged, faked. New n_identified weak columns mark groups whose interval rests fewer two well-identified surveys, whose capture probability falls new p_min argument (default 0.4) – removal estimate biased interval reliable. estimand stated reach mean density. Fixes four major findings 2026-06 audit (docs/electrocpue-audit-2026-06.md), follow-corrections review fixes: Declared R dependency now matches code. package uses native pipe |>, DESCRIPTION now requires R (>= 4.1.0) instead inherited R (>= 2.10), let package install R 4.0.x fail parse. validate_cpue_input() now checks reach extent. check_reach_extent_positive() rejects length_m 0, negative, NA (area_m2 <= 0 optional column present), closing gap let values pass validation silently produce Inf/NaN/negative density downstream. check restricted reaches catch_data references, master reach inventory carrying placeholder extents unsampled reaches still accepted. Optional columns now type-checked present, positivity checks longer abort battery non-numeric column. Non-depleting series flagged every method. catch decline across passes – pass catching many fish first, – estimate returned note = "assumption_violated" warning instead note = "ok". check spans every pass (just first last) applies zippin, carle_strub, auto alike, non-depleting series flagged whether Zippin happened converge . (series extreme search converge returned note = "no_convergence".) flag honoured downstream. analyze_cpue() now emits aggregate warning series violates assumption, summarize_cpue() excludes assumption_violated surveys abundance density means intervals – reporting new n_assumption_violated column – rather blending untrustworthy estimates group summary. summarize_cpue() averages CPUE surveys. observed CPUE (catch / effort) depend depletion fit, cpue_mean averaged every survey finite catch rate (infinite rate zero-effort survey dropped). Abundance density means remain restricted usable surveys. Minor-finding cleanup audit: Amp-second effort guards denominator. analyze_cpue() now rejects missing (NA) non-positive amperage effort_basis = "amp_seconds", instead silently producing NA meaningless catch rate. Within-pass effort consistency validated. validate_cpue_input() now rejects reach_id × date × pass_number whose species rows disagree effort_seconds (amperage) — data-entry error analyze_cpue() otherwise resolve silently keeping first value. Documentation. Clarified Carle & Strub standard errors Zippin large-sample approximation evaluated C&S point estimate; noted wide two-survey (df = 1) density interval; warned validate = FALSE forgoes contiguous-pass guard; added orphaned Zippin (1956) reference.

title: electrocpue 0.1.0
text: estimate_population() dispatches Zippin Carle & Strub removal-depletion estimators, "auto" mode prefers Zippin falls back Carle & Strub model failure. zippin_estimate() carle_strub_estimate() expose individual estimators. Point estimates standard errors match FSA::removal(); FSA test-time dependency . Edge cases follow clear conventions: single-pass series return NA warning, zero total catch returns N = 0, non-convergent series return NA warning.

title: electrocpue 0.1.0
text: analyze_cpue() wires validation, reshaping, estimation, effort standardization, density calculation single call, returning one tidy row per reach × date × species. build_pass_matrix() reshapes long catch data per-series pass-count vectors, filling absent passes zero summing duplicate species × pass rows. Effort can standardized raw seconds amp-seconds, aggregated per pass avoid double counting across species.
